Senses.Explanation: To laugh loudly—an audible “ha-ha” laugh recorded as an action in public encounters, sometimes followed by speech and sometimes serving as the whole turn. The exact phrase occurs 1,508 times in 278 allowlisted texts. The records preserve its range without assigning one fixed motive to it. Baizhang Huaihai laughs after a colleague asks why he had just cried and answers only, “Earlier I cried; now I laugh” (適來哭，如今笑). Zhaozhou Congshen laughs during an exchange and then repeats Hanshan's cry, “Heaven! Heaven!” (蒼天！蒼天). Jinniu Heshang dances with the rice tub, laughs loudly, and calls the assembly to eat (菩薩子。喫飯來). After an unnamed member of Baizhang's assembly reports returning to eat when he heard the meal drum, Baizhang laughs. Xiangshan Yunliang laughs after a pause and asks, “Laugh at what?” (笑箇甚麼). Yuanwu Keqin laughs and then calls his own address speech about a dream where there is no dream and an affair where none exists. Dahui Zonggao laughs after an unnamed questioner answers by saying farewell and immediately tests the next entrant about that response. Zen preserves the laugh as a public-interview speaker-turn and teaching-seat action rather than reducing it to an editorial report about emotion.
Senses.Note: Different occasions do not establish different things. The phrase consistently denotes the audible act of laughing; the texts do not authorize a menu of motives. The Baizhang crying/laughing support witness does not contain the exact four-character headword and is excluded from exact-headword depth.

Occurrences.Kwic: 適來哭，如今為甚却笑？師云：適來哭，如今笑
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Linked-Lamp Compendium (聯燈會要), section on Baizhang Huaihai. Baizhang's colleague asks why he now laughs after crying, and Baizhang answers only that earlier he cried and now he laughs. This family support does not count toward exact-headword depth.

Occurrences.Kwic: 舁飯桶到堂前作舞。呵呵大笑曰。菩薩子。喫飯來
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), section on Jinniu Heshang. Jinniu carries the rice tub before the hall, dances, laughs loudly, and calls the assembly to eat.

Occurrences.Kwic: 州呵呵大笑。山曰：作什麼？州曰：蒼天！蒼天
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Collected Comments on Old Cases of the Chan Gate (宗門拈古彙集), Hanshan and Zhaozhou case. Zhaozhou Congshen laughs; Hanshan asks what he is doing, and Zhaozhou repeats Hanshan's cry, “Heaven! Heaven!”

Occurrences.Kwic: 某甲早辰未喫粥聞鼓聲歸喫飯師呵呵大笑
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), Recorded Sayings of Baizhang Huaihai. A monk says he returned to eat when he heard the drum because he had not eaten gruel that morning; Baizhang laughs loudly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 良久，呵呵大笑曰：笑箇甚麼
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Strict Transmission of the Five Lamps, volumes 10–25 (五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)), section on Xiangshan Yunliang. After a pause, Xiangshan laughs loudly and asks what is being laughed at. Xiangshan Yunliang is not yet in the roster; the section heading supplies the provisional pinyin form.

Occurrences.Kwic: 乃呵呵大笑云。山僧恁麼說話。大似無夢說夢無事生事。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄). Yuanwu Keqin laughs and calls his own speech comparable to speaking of a dream without a dream and producing an affair where none exists.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧珍重便行。師呵呵大笑。次一僧入。師云。我適來問這僧。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師語錄). After an unnamed questioner responds by saying farewell and leaving, Dahui Zonggao laughs loudly; he then asks the next entrant whether the first one understood.

Occurrences.Kwic: 如水潦問馬祖。本來佛法。祖與一踏倒地。忽然大悟。起來呵呵大笑云。百千三昧無量妙義。只向一毫頭。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄). Yuanwu Keqin cites Shuilao Heshang laughing loudly after Mazu knocks him down and beginning his own statement about the many samadhis and meanings. The quoted laugh is Shuilao's; he is not yet in the roster, so the pinyin form is provisional.
